rv.q: Scandalous may be a marshmallow of a show stuck together with dopey, on-the-nose lyrics, derivative tunes, and a libretto with the psychological and literary depth of a Sunday school coloring book.
It's also not interesting, alas, at least not interesting enough to sustain 21/2 hours of fast-forward storytelling and inspirational songs that almost always end in throbbing climax.

Kathie Lee Gifford's biographical musical about evangelist Aimee Semple McPherson is a well-intentioned but dramatically inert production that fails to bring much life to its larger-than-life subject.
